statement: Terminal landing no longer stops with committed: no (commit-gate) when the only paths outside the recorded attempt union are registered generated outputs (the test-classification manifests and the import-graph seal) whose bytes are byte-identical to a fresh regeneration from the exact candidate snapshot: scripts/solve/generated-dependencies.js exposes generatedOutputCoverage (typed FRESH/STALE/UNAVAILABLE), the landing union guard treats only FRESH outputs as covered and rides them in the terminal commit scope, while STALE or UNAVAILABLE outputs and every non-generated path keep blocking with the union guard's unchanged code; the land step order is untouched. Proven deterministically on the real landing preflight and commit path with the exact two-step sequence of 2026-08-30: red on HEAD (commit-gate stop, second land needed), green after (one land commits union plus fresh seal).

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
The Solver landing/attempt owner under scripts/solve remains the single authority; no duplicated predicate is introduced elsewhere.

A registered generated output (including the import-graph seal) is covered at landing iff its bytes equal a fresh regeneration from the exact candidate snapshot; STALE or UNAVAILABLE stays uncovered and blocks with the union guard's existing code.
The land step order is untouched; coverage is evaluated only when every uncovered path is a registered generated output, and the union guard's block for any other path is byte-for-byte unchanged.
Proof is a deterministic replay of the recorded operator sequence through the real Solver modules on a temporary repository fixture, red on HEAD and green after, with controls that must stay green.
